_deal: The board's test node. This build empties it, so anything else on it leaves the board until rebuilt or restored.
author: eliza
source: his 2026-11-12 13:20 "yeah build the board": OT-24, a ship boarded in orbit, his remote qst12/qst14's derelict on stock hooks
_note: BOARDING PROBE BD1 (plan OT-24): sk1's ship, derelict and dark, a Spacer crew, silent, placeholder words. Not a mission.
Reading it: take it, go to the system. The ship should be there after the accept, dead in space (no engines, outside lights off), so it can be docked. Dock and board.
Inside: gravity rolled (none, low or normal), most lights out, a Spacer crew, and the item at one of their spots; the objective moves to it. Pick it up: the mission completes and pays easy.
Papyrus.0.log, [board] lines: stage 60 (loaded), stage 70 (boarded, N crew markers, the item, the crew). Destroying the ship before boarding should fail the mission ([board] stage 90).
